runtime_policy.malformed_input: fail closed; do not synthesize or repair content

closures: Every supplied HSE and STO override is 7-bit ASCII with LF-only line endings and no carriage returns.
HSE filenames encode a decimal house ID followed by invariant suffix 15; the first logical line is a title and the remaining lines are the verbatim body.
STO files contain exactly four logical lines: three description lines and one terminal identity marker naming the canonical WCC filename, followed by LF; WBB copies preserve that WCC marker.
The native-compatible managed boundary must preserve raw bytes and line endings rather than normalizing text.
limitations: The exact native open/read buffer size and missing/malformed fallback branch remain unproven.
